notes: Superscription and petition align morpheme by morpheme; the article on the rectum is unrepresented because the ASV writes no *the* for the phrase (rule 29), and the supplied *A* joins `שִׁיר` under rule 15.

`כֹּל` keeps only *All*: the ASV writes no *of* between the quantifying construct and its rectum, so rule 19 has no relational word to place. The object marker is unrepresented, the ASV writing the object bare (rule 16).
